For example:

```python
from sqlglot import parse_one, transpile, exp

transpile("SELECT JSON_QUERY(x, '$.a')", read="tsql", write="trino")[0]
# currently: SELECT JSON_QUERY(x, '$.a')
# expected:  SELECT JSON_QUERY(x, 'lax $.a')
```

+        # dialects that don't have one (e.g. T-SQL) are parsed into a JSONPath, so we prefix the
